about: Generated mood imagery for the Lady L Cannabis redesign pitch (IMAGERY lane, 2026-11-04), design LAVENDER PARLOR: Art Deco x bohemian parlor, clean and modern editorial photography in deep aubergine-violet, lavender, sunflower gold, coral, sky blue and warm cream. Every image is AI-generated mood imagery only: none shows, or stands in for, Lady L's store, staff, customers, products, brands or any real place, and every alt describes what is depicted. fal entries run with: node tools/fal-gen.mjs --plan src/content/image-plan.json --key-file <path outside the project> --concurrency 4. Entries marked external: higgsfield-mcp were generated through the Higgsfield MCP (z_image) and labelled with tools/ai-label.mjs; reuse: true makes fal-gen skip them. Cut-outs (cutout: true) are generated on a plain background, then cut out with birefnet v2 (Matting) to a transparent PNG.

defaults.style: Clean, modern editorial photograph with a bohemian Art Deco parlor sensibility, rich but muted colour drawn from deep aubergine-violet, soft periwinkle lavender, sunflower-yellow gold accents, soft coral, pale sky-blue highlights and warm cream, matte surfaces, soft warm light, fine natural film grain. No people, no hands, no faces, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no signage, every surface blank and unmarked, nothing candy-like, no alcohol, no vehicles, no neon, no iridescent or holographic finishes.

usedFor: home hero stage backdrop (with the hero-haze loop)
images.negativeSpace: left 45% dark, calm violet wall for the headline; furniture and plants in the right half
images.alt: A dim plum-violet Art Deco lounge at dusk: a brass sunburst mirror, a lavender velvet armchair with a coral cushion, a glowing brass lamp, pampas grass, a potted palm in a rattan basket and an arched window.
images.prompt: Wide interior photograph of a moody Art Deco bohemian parlor lounge at dusk, seen straight on. Composition: the entire left half of the frame is an empty, calm, dark deep aubergine-violet plaster wall in deep shadow above a dark floor, with no furniture and no objects at all. Everything sits in the right half: a large round brass Art Deco sunburst mirror with long straight radiating brass rays on the wall, reflecting only a soft blurred wall; below it a lavender velvet armchair with one coral cushion; beside it a tall arched window showing only a soft violet dusk sky; a potted cannabis plant with distinctive serrated seven-fingered fan leaves in a woven rattan basket; tall plumes of pale pampas grass in a cream terrazzo planter; a small brass table lamp glowing warm amber-gold. Low-key cinematic light, warm lamp glow against cool violet dusk, soft deep shadows, calm and luxurious but homely
images.rejectReason: attempt 1: the sofa filled the lower left (the left 45% must stay calm and dark), the plants read as palms, no sunburst mirror

buildNotes.calm: left 45%: plain dark plum wall (a dark potted palm sits low at 12-31% of the width); brightest elements: lamp and window at the far right
buildNotes.crop: object-position about 60% 50%; keep the right edge (lamp, window) in frame

images.negativeSpace: upper two thirds calm; the sunburst rises from the bottom centre
images.alt: A pale lavender wall with an Art Deco sunburst relief traced in fine gold lines, in soft raking light.
images.prompt: Architectural detail photograph of a smooth matte lavender plaster wall carved with a large shallow Art Deco sunburst relief: long straight rays fan upward and outward from a half-circle at the bottom centre edge of the frame like a rising sun, each ray edged with a fine line of gold leaf. Soft raking light from the left casts gentle shadows along the relief. Calm and minimal, large plain areas of wall above, muted lavender and pale lavender tones with fine sunflower-gold lines and a warm cream highlight

buildNotes.calm: upper fifth and both outer sixths
buildNotes.crop: object-position 50% 100% keeps the sunburst rising from the bottom

images.alt: A dark violet room with golden light rays falling through an arched window onto the floor.
images.prompt: Wide atmospheric photograph of a dark, nearly empty violet room with Art Deco plaster mouldings, the air filled with soft drifting lavender haze. A tall arched window in the right third of the frame lets slow golden light rays stream diagonally down through the haze toward the floor right of centre, the beams clearly visible as soft volumetric shafts, a few floating dust motes glinting gold. The left 40 percent of the frame stays dark, calm deep aubergine-violet haze with nothing in it. No furniture. Deep aubergine-violet shadows, lavender haze, sunflower-gold rays, a hint of pale sky blue in the window glass

buildNotes.crop: object-position 70% 50% keeps the window and rays
